_comment: Reference list of environment variables for Vercel. Secrets must be added in Vercel (Project > Settings > Environment Variables, or scripts/set-vercel-env.sh). Never commit real keys.

required.GROQ_API_KEY: at least ONE of GROQ_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY is needed

recommended.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL: enables rate limiting shared across serverless instances (KV_REST_API_URL also works)
